unit.title: Fractions
unit.blurb: Fractions as parts of a whole and as division, unit and non-unit fractions, and finding fractions of numbers and quantities.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Understand fractions as parts of a whole and as the result of a division.

O2.t: Use fractions as operators to find fractions of numbers and quantities.

p: The **denominator** tells you how many equal parts the whole is split into; the **numerator** tells you how many parts you have. **3/8** = 3 of 8 equal parts.
A fraction can be a **division**: 3 pizzas shared by 4 children gives each child 3 ÷ 4 = **3/4** of a pizza.
Only equal parts can be called eighths.
